name: Lead Capture & Initial Contact
remarks: Objective: Perform 5-10 min discovery call to qualify budget, timeline, and core requirements. Deliverable: Qualified CRM Record, Client Brief Sheet, Budget Fit Matrix. Exit Gate: Lead qualified with core requirements and site location logged in system..

name: Initial Presentation / Demo
remarks: Objective: Demonstrate clear value and get agreement from client to move to cost estimation. Deliverable: Tailored Presentation Deck, Finishes Board Demo, Client Consensus Note. Exit Gate: Client confirms interest and agrees to advance to cost estimation stage..

name: Scope Alignment
remarks: Objective: Ensure client expectations match what will be quoted in initial proposal. Deliverable: Preliminary Scope Document, Room-by-Room Deliverables List, Assumptions Memo. Exit Gate: Scope alignment document signed off or formally acknowledged by client..

name: Rough Quotation
remarks: Objective: Validate financial fit before spending resources on deep technical scope documents. Deliverable: Preliminary Rough Estimate BOQ, Stage Payment Matrix, High-level Phasing Plan. Exit Gate: Rough estimate approved by client without commercial deadlock..

name: Token Amount Request
remarks: Objective: Lock in client commitment and prioritize their project slot. Deliverable: Letter of Intent (LOI), Token Payment Receipt, Priority Slot Allocation. Exit Gate: Token payment realized and signed Letter of Intent on file..

name: Handover & Kickoff
remarks: Objective: Transition smoothly from sales to execution. Deliverable: Confirmation Receipt, Draft SOW, Kickoff Meeting Minutes, Assigned PM/Designer Dossier. Exit Gate: Sales-to-Ops handoff meeting completed; Phase 2 (Design) formally opened..

name: Site Measurements
remarks: Objective: Capture accurate physical dimensions & site conditions. Deliverable: As-built site dimensions, beam/column locations, utility points. Exit Gate: Verified as-built site CAD survey drawing logged..

name: Initial 3D Design
remarks: Objective: Concept visualization & spatial layout planning. Deliverable: Conceptual 3D views, spatial flow, tentative color schemes. Exit Gate: Conceptual 3D layout signed off by client..

name: Selections
remarks: Objective: Finalize materials, finishes, fixtures, & hardware. Deliverable: Material board sign-off (laminates, veneers, fabrics, hardware). Exit Gate: Material board sign-off sheet approved with vendor codes..

name: Final 3D Design
remarks: Objective: High-precision visualization based on selected materials. Deliverable: Photorealistic final 3D renders with exact materials applied. Exit Gate: Photorealistic final 3D renders formally approved by client..

name: Site Validation
remarks: Objective: Re-verify site conditions against the approved design. Deliverable: On-site markup/check for plumbing, electrical, and structural fit. Exit Gate: Site validation checklist executed; zero on-site geometric clashes..

name: Final 2D / Production Drawings
remarks: Objective: Prepare technical drawings for factory/site manufacturing. Deliverable: Working drawings (elevations, sections, electrical, plumbing layouts). Exit Gate: Complete stamped GFC 2D Production Drawing Package released..

name: KT to Execution Team
remarks: Objective: Knowledge transfer to project managers & site supervisors. Deliverable: Design handoff meeting, drawing pack sign-off, execution briefing. Exit Gate: KT sign-off agreement signed; drawing package transferred to factory & site..

name: Floor Protection
remarks: Objective: Safeguard finished floors against scratches & debris. Deliverable: Protective sheet/Gypsum board covering. Exit Gate: Floor fully covered and secured..

name: Framing & Channeling
remarks: Objective: Install metal grid framework for ceiling support. Deliverable: Levelled perimeter & main GI grid structure. Exit Gate: Rigid, level metal grid framework established..

name: Thermal Insulation
remarks: Objective: Install sound/heat insulation layer in grid cavity. Deliverable: Rockwool / Glasswool insulation laid in place. Exit Gate: Insulation layer securely placed above the grid frame..

name: Electrical Wiring
remarks: Objective: Lay ceiling conduits and pull electrical cables. Deliverable: Conduits secured & wire drop-points created. Exit Gate: All ceiling electrical lines pulled and safely isolated..

name: AC Copper Piping
remarks: Objective: Route refrigerant lines and drain pipes for AC units. Deliverable: Pressure-tested AC copper lines & drain outlets. Exit Gate: AC piping installed, insulated, and pressure-verified..

name: Ceiling Woodwork
remarks: Objective: Install wooden features, coves, or paneling structures. Deliverable: Wooden framing/coving support ready for board. Exit Gate: Wooden features and cove structural framing installed..

name: Board Fixing
remarks: Objective: Mount gypsum, calcium silicate, or cement boards. Deliverable: Screwed & aligned board ceiling surface. Exit Gate: Fully boarded ceiling with smooth joints..

name: Painting Sub-tasks
remarks: Objective: Achieve smooth, seamless ceiling surface & final color. Deliverable: Joint taping, Putty, Primer, & Final Paint coats. Exit Gate: Smooth, painted ceiling surface..

name: Final Electrical Fitting
remarks: Objective: Cut fixture openings & install light fittings. Deliverable: COB lights, strip lights, & fan fittings mounted. Exit Gate: All lights, coves, and fixtures fully operational..

name: Site Cleaning
remarks: Objective: Clean ceiling surface, remove floor protection & debris. Deliverable: Handover-ready site with clean ceiling & floors. Exit Gate: Clean, defect-free false ceiling ready for client sign-off..

name: Demolition
remarks: Objective: Dismantle non-structural walls, tiles, and old fittings safely. Deliverable: Cleared site & rubble/debris disposal. Exit Gate: Clean, cleared site ready for new construction..

name: Reconstruction
remarks: Objective: Build new layout walls, partitions, and structural bases. Deliverable: Blockwork/brickwork walls & door/window frames set. Exit Gate: Complete structural wall framework and partitions constructed..

name: Punning
remarks: Objective: Apply smooth plaster/punning coat to align walls level. Deliverable: Level, plumb, and smooth wall surfaces. Exit Gate: Plumb, smooth, and crack-free wall surfaces..

name: Plumbing Work
remarks: Objective: Core cutting, routing water supply, drainage & waste lines. Deliverable: Pressure-tested plumbing lines & concealed traps. Exit Gate: Pressure-tested and approved concealed plumbing network..

name: Electrical Work
remarks: Objective: Chase walls for conduits, fix switch boxes & pull wiring. Deliverable: Wall conduits chased, back-boxes fixed & wired. Exit Gate: Wall conduits sealed, back-boxes set, and internal wiring completed..

name: Woodwork (Carpentry)
remarks: Objective: On-site assembly, fitting, and paneling installation. Deliverable: Framed cabinets, door frames, paneling, and moldings set. Exit Gate: All wooden framework, cabinetry, and cladding structurally completed..

name: Stone & Marble Work
remarks: Objective: Countertop fitting, stone cladding, edge molding, and grouting. Deliverable: Installed granite/marble countertops, wall stone cladding & sealed joints. Exit Gate: Stone surfaces fixed, leveled, edge-profiled, and grouted..

name: Polishing / PU Works
remarks: Objective: Surface sanding, staining, and Polyurethane (PU) coating. Deliverable: Premium veneer, solid wood, or MDF polished/PU painted surfaces. Exit Gate: Cured, smooth PU or polished timber finish with zero runs or dust spots..

name: Wall Painting
remarks: Objective: Wall preparation, putty, primer, and topcoat application. Deliverable: Smooth, finished walls free of blemishes or patches. Exit Gate: Evenly coated, stain-free wall surfaces with clean paint cut-lines..

name: Final Cleaning
remarks: Objective: Deep cleaning, polish residue removal, and trash clearance. Deliverable: Spotless, move-in/handover-ready interior space. Exit Gate: Spotless, dust-free interior ready for final quality inspection and client handover..

name: Drawing Forwarded to Factory
remarks: Objective: Hand over approved 2D/production drawings to factory. Deliverable: Approved Production Drawing Package. Exit Gate: Drawing intake confirmed by factory technical office..

name: Factory Cutlist Generation
remarks: Objective: Convert 2D drawings into precise panel cutlists & hardware counts. Deliverable: Draft Cutlist & Hardware Breakdown. Exit Gate: Initial Cutlist & Hardware Schedule prepared..

name: R1 (PO) Review
remarks: Objective: First-level technical & quantity verification against site specs. Deliverable: R1 Reviewed Cutlist with Feedback/Corrections. Exit Gate: R1 Cutlist markup & PM verification completed..

name: R2 (PO) Recheck
remarks: Objective: Second-level verification to prevent material wastage & errors. Deliverable: Final Checked Cutlist. Exit Gate: Fully verified and error-free Cutlist..

name: Production Approval
remarks: Objective: Sign off on validated cutlists to authorise procurement. Deliverable: Approved Production Order (PO Sign-Off). Exit Gate: Signed Production Order (PO Approval)..

name: Material List Generation
remarks: Objective: Generate Bill of Materials (BOM) based on approved cutlist. Deliverable: Bill of Materials (BOM) / Requisition Sheet. Exit Gate: Generated Bill of Materials (BOM)..

name: Material Availability Check
remarks: Objective: Audit current stock against required BOM. Deliverable: Inventory Audit Report (In-Stock vs. Shortfall). Exit Gate: Material Audit Report identifying In-Stock items vs. Procurement needs..

name: Material Procurement
remarks: Objective: Purchase required raw materials, hardware, and finishes. Deliverable: Purchase Orders Issued & Goods Received Note (GRN). Exit Gate: All required project materials received and stored in production bay..

name: Production Start
remarks: Objective: Issue materials to the shop floor and commence manufacturing. Deliverable: Job Card Issued & Cutting/Assembly Underway. Exit Gate: Active Production Status (Job Card in Execution)..

name: Carcase Assembly
remarks: Objective: Erect, level, and anchor cabinet carcass boxes. Deliverable: Square, plumb, and wall-anchored carcass structures. Exit Gate: Levelled and rigid carcass structure ready for internal fittings..

name: Drawers Installation
remarks: Objective: Mount drawer channels, runners, and inner drawer boxes. Deliverable: Smooth-sliding, aligned tandem/drawer boxes. Exit Gate: Smooth, noise-free drawer sliding operation with flush seating..

name: Lighting Fixing
remarks: Objective: Embed LED channels, profile drivers, and sensors. Deliverable: Functional internal & under-cabinet LED lighting. Exit Gate: Fully wired, illuminated internal and task lighting units..

name: Accessories Fitting
remarks: Objective: Install internal storage mechanisms & pull-outs. Deliverable: Fitted cutlery trays, corner units, & tall units. Exit Gate: Fully functional, smooth-operating hardware accessories..

name: Shutters & Visibles
remarks: Objective: Mount front door shutters, end panels, & fillers. Deliverable: Aligned shutter fronts with uniform gaps. Exit Gate: Seamless, aligned front shutters with balanced gap lines..

name: Dummies & Skirting
remarks: Objective: Attach bottom skirting PVC/aluminum & top dummy trims. Deliverable: Sealed cabinet bases and clean ceiling/wall gaps. Exit Gate: Clean, flush finish without open gaps under or above cabinets..

name: Ready to Inspect (L1 & L2)
remarks: Objective: Perform two-stage quality checks for final client sign-off. Deliverable: Defect-free, verified modular installation. Exit Gate: Approved L1 & L2 Quality Check Sign-off sheet..
